name: Pi by Placer.ai
description:
Every business decision has a physical dimension. Where to open. Which markets are gaining. Who's actually walking through the door — and where they go next. Until now, that was the one thing Claude couldn't see.

Pi changes that. It brings Placer.ai's location intelligence into Claude, so you can answer questions about the physical world in the same place you do the rest of your thinking — foot traffic, sales, visitor demographics, trade areas, cross-shopping, and more — across millions of places.

Pi does the work — finding the right locations, pulling the relevant data, running the analysis — and comes back with a clear, written answer you can act on, including any caveats about the data behind it. Work that used to take an analyst days now happens inside the conversation you're already having.

That same conversation happens across dozens of industries — retail, real estate, investors, cities, advertisers, and more, each asking where to grow, what to trust, where to put their attention next.

The physical world just became something Claude can reason about.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pi by Placer.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pi by Placer.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pi.placer.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pi by Placer.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi by Placer.ai provides these MCP tools: ask_pi and get_pi_result.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pi by Placer.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pi by Placer.ai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Pi by Placer.ai MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi by Placer.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pi by Placer.ai is developed by Placer.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
